contributions.anchor: Form A's own printed chain, which closes on the cover's CUMULATIVE line-1 cell: June block 'Total $62,284' (p9) + July block 'Sub Total $10,950' (p9) = the p10 'Total / Nov. Report $73,234' = the cover's 'Totals from Last Report'; + the 11/19/18 $400 row = p10's 'Total Contributions / Year End Report $73,634' = the cover's CUMULATIVE 73,634.00
contributions.detail: TRACED DELTA of exactly 1,000.00, retained verbatim as the FILER's arithmetic and never adjusted. The 31 transcribed Form A rows sum to 74,634.00 against the printed 73,634.00. The June block closes to the cent (24 rows = 62,284.00 = its own printed Total). The July block's six rows sum to 11,950.00 against the filer's own printed Sub Total of 10,950.00: his subtotal OMITS ITS OWN LAST ROW, 8/23/18 WC GOP $1,000.00 (the Rowley pattern). That 10,950.00 is what he then carries into 73,234.00 and into the cover, so the cover is internally consistent with his page arithmetic and the $1,000 row is genuinely un-summed rather than mis-read. Cover line 1 is a 3-line form (contrib_all), so there is no <=$50 aggregate line to explain any part of the residual. This is a FINAL (Jan 7th, 2019) report on an officeholder account, but the 'Totals from Last Report' column here is this same 2018 cycle's earlier reports - Form A restates the WHOLE cycle, so the schedule is cumulative-scoped, not period-scoped.

expenditures.anchor: Form B's own printed 'Grand Total $70,488.53' on p13, against the cover's line-2 CUMULATIVE cell of 70,017.23
expenditures.detail: TRACED DELTA of exactly 471.30, retained verbatim. The 55 transcribed Form B rows sum to 70,488.53, matching p13's own printed Grand Total to the cent, and every one of its three internal anchors closes exactly: block 1 = 52,307.95 ('Filed 06/19/2018 Total'), block 2 = 15,148.28 ('Sub Total', running Grand Total 67,456.23), block 3 = 3,032.30 ('Sub Total', Grand Total 70,488.53). The schedule is internally perfect. The cover's 70,017.23 is LOWER by 471.30 because the packet binds TWO copies of the same Form B: p12 is the 12/21/2018 year-end version whose third block has only 3 rows (Sub Total 2,561.00, Grand Total 70,017.23 - exactly the cover's This-Report and Cumulative cells), and p13 is a later 12/31/2018 'File Final Report' version of the identical schedule with 3 MORE rows: 11/15/18 Curtis Wells Campaign 250.00 + 12/24/18 Zucca 21.30 + 12/24/18 JW Hats 200.00 = 471.30. The filer updated his schedule and did not update his cover. The fuller p13 copy is transcribed (it is a strict superset of p12, so nothing is double-counted and nothing is dropped); the cover is left as the module already publishes it.
